name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small-savings scheme for girl children (under 10 at opening) with attractive tax-free returns.
eligibility: Parents/guardians of a girl child below age 10; one account per child (max 2 per family).
benefits: High interest (govt-set), tax-free, partial withdrawal for education/marriage at 18+.
application_steps: Open at post office or authorised bank.
office_locator_info: Refer to official portal / nearest office
ai_summary: SSY is a government small-savings scheme for girl children with tax-free high returns.
ai_explanation: Small-savings scheme for girl children (under 10 at opening) with attractive tax-free returns.
